title.narrative: Strengthening Climate Adaptation, Resilience, Livelihoods, and Gender Inclusion in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties_ADSW

description.narrative: This project aims to enhance climate adaptation, resilience, and economic growth at the community level in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties by promoting inclusive and effective climate finance strategies and sustainable practices. This will be achieved through improved communication, transparency, and accountability in the distribution and management of climate funds, fostering inclusive decision-making and optimal resource utilization. By strengthening communication channels, monitoring systems, and reporting frameworks, the project will enhance public confidence and ensure that community priorities are reflected in climate action initiatives, leading to more impactful outcomes. Additionally, this project seeks to increase access to climate finance for vulnerable and marginalized groups, particularly women. This will strengthen local resilience and facilitate more effective adaptation strategies, allowing these groups to engage fully in climate resilience efforts. Improved governance and coordination systems for climate finance will enhance management, transparency, and collaboration among stakeholders, leading to more equitable and impactful climate actions. This project also emphasizes the need for local communities to prepare for the evolving challenges posed by climate change. Recognizing that there is no one-size-fits-all solution, it will focus on awareness-raising and capacity-building efforts tailored to the diverse ecosystems and socio-economic conditions of the regions. The project will assess various livelihood systems, profiling vulnerable groups, conduct participatory climate risk assessments, and examine the impacts of past and current climate events. By addressing these areas, this project will promote institutional and technical capacity building within key agencies and community organizations, enabling them to deliver demand-responsive services that better equip communities to adapt to climate change effectively.
